scope: All fifteen previously undated rows of the 31-entry catalogue
display_policy: Verified event years use plain rails; publication/preparation years use a visible superscript asterisk and a visible, accessible note identifying the resource year. A page legend explains the distinction. No resource-only year is emitted as datetime or dt-start.
unchanged: All 31 rows, row order, all external resource hrefs, original ten complete h-event rows including all tuple values. No private/publish:false source edited.
